description: This Java source file defines the `GiftCertificateServices` class, which provides services for managing gift certificates within the OFBiz framework. Its functionalities include creating gift certificates, adding funds, redeeming, checking balance, processing fulfillments, authorizing, refunding, releasing, reloading, and tracking fulfillment records. The class interacts with various OFBiz entities and services to perform operations such as account creation, transaction management, survey responses, email notifications, and gift certificate fulfillment activities.

classes.name: GiftCertificateServices
classes.description: Service class providing methods for creating, managing, and tracking gift certificates within the OFBiz framework. Implements functionalities such as creation, funding, redemption, balance check, fulfillment processing, authorization, refund, release, reload, and fulfillment record creation.

methods.name: createGiftCertificate
methods.description: Creates a new gift certificate, including generating account details, possibly a PIN, and initial transaction. Returns details such as cardNumber, pinNumber, initialAmount, processResult, responseCode, and referenceNum.

methods.name: addFundsToGiftCertificate
methods.description: Adds funds to an existing gift certificate identified by card and PIN, updating the account balance and returning previous and new balances along with transaction details.

methods.name: redeemGiftCertificate
methods.description: Redeems a gift certificate against an order, deducting the specified amount if sufficient balance exists, and returning updated balances and transaction info.

methods.name: checkGiftCertificateBalance
methods.description: Checks the available balance of a gift certificate, validating PIN and returning current balance.

methods.name: giftCertificateProcessor
methods.description: Processes the fulfillment of a gift certificate, such as capturing or processing an authorization, and managing related authorization transactions.

methods.name: giftCertificateAuthorize
methods.description: Validates and authorizes a gift certificate for a specified amount, creating an authorization transaction if sufficient balance exists.

methods.name: giftCertificateRefund
methods.description: Restores or refunds a gift certificate, adding the amount back to the account and tracking the activity.

methods.name: giftCertificateRelease
methods.description: Releases a gift certificate authorization, expiring related authorization entries.

methods.name: giftCertificateRestore
methods.description: Handles the process of reloading a gift certificate based on survey responses, creating an account activity, and sending notifications.

methods.name: giftCertificatePurchase
methods.description: Handles the process of purchasing gift certificates related to an order item, including survey collection, account creation, fulfillment record creation, and email notification.

methods.name: giftCertificateReload
methods.description: Processes reloading an existing gift certificate based on survey responses and transaction data, with fulfillment record creation and email notifications.

methods.name: createFulfillmentRecord
methods.description: Creates a record tracking the fulfillment activity for a gift certificate, including details like type, party, order, amounts, and response codes.

methods.name: refundGcPurchase
methods.description: Handles processing refunds for gift certificate purchases, updating records accordingly.

methods.name: createReturnItem
methods.description: Creates a return item and updates return header status, including error handling and logging.

methods.name: updateReturnReturnHeaderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the return header to 'RETURN_RECEIVED' after creating the return item, with error handling.

methods.name: validatePin
methods.description: Validates the PIN against the stored finAccountCode in the FinAccount entity for a given card number.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Creates a financial transaction (deposit or withdrawal) related to gift certificates, including creating payment records and account transactions.

methods.name: generateNumber
methods.description: Generates a random numeric string of specified length, ensuring validity as an ID if required, avoiding duplicates in database.

methods.name: checkNumberInDatabase
methods.description: Checks if a finAccountId already exists in the database to ensure unique IDs.

methods.name: checkCardNumber
methods.description: Validates a card number using the Luhn algorithm, ensuring it's a valid number.

methods.name: getPayToPartyId
methods.description: Retrieves the pay-to-party ID associated with a product store, defaulting to 'Company' if not specified.
